Patient guide

Your first visit.

What to expect at your new patient exam.

Getting to know you.

We review your health history and talk about your goals for your smile.

Digital x-rays.

Quick, very low radiation, and they show what the eye can't.

A thorough exam.

Your dentist checks each tooth, your gums, and your bite, plus an oral cancer screening.

A gentle cleaning.

If your gums are healthy, we clean and polish your teeth. If you need more care, we'll schedule it.

Your personal plan.

We explain what we found, your options, and costs up front. No surprises.

No insurance? No problem.

Ask about our membership plan: routine care for one simple yearly price, plus savings on treatment.

A few things make your first visit quick and easy.
